groups.name: Panel collapse mechanism
groups.rationale: Introduces the core feature: a collapsible panel controlled by a rail that stays visible when shut, with state tracking and UI labels.
groups.watch: The rail badge and label logic must correctly distinguish between queued feedback (shown when shut) and the panel state (shown when open); agentSpokeAgain must not fire on the reviewer's own messages or re-groups.

groups.name: Breakpoint calculation for panel state
groups.rationale: Updates the viewport query logic to account for the panel's absence when collapsed, allowing side-by-side to reflow earlier at lower widths.
groups.watch: The collapsed breakpoint must be exactly COLUMNS_MIN_PX minus PANEL_WIDTH_PX, or the view toggle will hide side-by-side at widths where it fits when the panel is shut.

groups.name: Layout grid and rail styling
groups.rationale: Restructures the body grid to make room for the rail column, styles the rail and its badge, and adjusts header text wrapping to prevent overflow when the panel collapses.
groups.watch: The grid-template-columns must define three columns (content, auto rail, panel); the chevron rotation must point at what the click does; the panel width constant must match the one in view-format.ts.

groups.name: Panel rail DOM and wiring
groups.rationale: Creates the rail UI component that toggles collapse state, reads and updates the queued count badge, and expands the panel when the agent speaks.
groups.watch: The rail must set data-panel on the page body, not itself; onToggle must fire only when collapsed state changes, not on queued count updates; expand must not fire onToggle when the panel is already open.

groups.name: Panel mount refactoring for callbacks
groups.rationale: Restructures mountPanel to accept an options object and adds an onPending callback so the rail can show the queued count.
groups.watch: onPending must be called on every pending queue change, including the initial draw; the callback should never be called twice with the same count.

groups.name: View toggle refresh for dynamic room queries
groups.rationale: Changes view toggle from a single static viewport query to a function that re-evaluates based on current panel state, and exposes a refresh method for the panel collapse to call.
groups.watch: refresh must call effectiveFormat with the current hasRoom() result; the refresh method must not be called during initialization or it will cause redundant renders.

groups.name: Main wiring and state management
groups.rationale: Orchestrates all components: extracts page elements, wires the rail with toggle callbacks, connects agent speak detection to panel expansion, and manages per-state room queries.
groups.watch: The panel state must be toggled before calling view.refresh() so hasRoom() reads the correct state; agentSpokeAgain must be checked after fresh conversation arrives but before view refresh; the rail expand must not persist state across sessions.

groups.name: HTML template initial state
groups.rationale: Adds the rail button to the template and initializes the page with data-panel='open' to set the starting state.
groups.watch: The rail button must have aria-controls, aria-expanded and aria-label attributes for accessibility; the data-panel attribute on body is what the stylesheet matches for layout.

groups.name: Documentation update
groups.rationale: Marks the panel collapse task as complete and documents the implementation details: rail positioning, badge behavior, breakpoint changes, and header text wrapping.
groups.watch: The measured column counts (98 to 134 at 1440px, 147 to 184 at 1920px) should reflect the actual impact of removing 352px; the persistence note is clear that state does not carry between sessions.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
